<thought>Using the retrieved DBE formula DBE = (2C + 2 + N - H - X) / 2 and the molecular formula C10H13 (C=10, H=13, N=0, X=0), the calculation yields (20 + 2 - 13) / 2 = 9/2 = 4.5. Since DBE must be reported as an integer, we round to the nearest whole number, giving 5.</thought>
<final_answer>5</final_answer>
